instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the following CSS-only static micro-polish ideas to elevate the Kids Hub spatiality. All existing components, layouts, and data-testids MUST be preserved. No DOM destruction. No motion or animations.
top_recommendation: Idea 2: The Guiding Thread (Static Path) - Ship this first! It directly solves the missing 'stepping stones' feeling by connecting the staggered cards into a journey, creating a room out of a list without touching the DOM.

ideas.name: The House Vignette (Spatial Frame)
ideas.why_it_raises_wow: It instantly transforms the viewport from a flat scrolling webpage into a 'room' by adding ambient grounding and edge-darkening, framing the content.
ideas.css_technique: Add a pointer-events-none fixed overlay with 'box-shadow: inset 0 0 120px rgba(...)' and a bottom-anchored 'radial-gradient' that creates a static 'floor' for the cards to float above.
ideas.per_age_variation: Little Dreamers: Warm peach/cream inset glow. Explorers: Soft sage/moss inset shadow. Dreamweavers: Ethereal lavender/mint edge blur.
ideas.brand_risk_check: Low risk. If the inset shadow is too dark, it might feel claustrophobic; keep opacity under 10-15% to maintain the airy house tone.

ideas.name: The Guiding Thread (Static Path)
ideas.why_it_raises_wow: It visually connects the already-staggered cards, turning a list into a cohesive 'journey' and mimicking the requested stepping-stone path.
ideas.css_technique: Apply a '::before' pseudo-element on the card grid container using a static, inline SVG background (a curving dashed/dotted path) positioned absolutely behind the cards (z-index: -1).
ideas.per_age_variation: Little Dreamers: Soft, rounded, close-knit dots (cream). Explorers: Slightly organic, leaf-like dashes (forest green). Dreamweavers: Varying sized star-dust dots (mint).
ideas.brand_risk_check: Low risk. Must remain low-contrast (10-15% opacity). If too prominent, it risks feeling like a gamified FOMO map.

ideas.name: Aurin's Anchor (Sticky Sparkle)
ideas.why_it_raises_wow: It solves the 'Aurin disappears on scroll' issue by keeping a tiny, abstracted piece of Aurin's presence in the viewport at all times.
ideas.css_technique: Add a fixed 'bottom-8 right-8' div containing the existing static sparkle SVG, styled with 'backdrop-blur-md', a 1px 'border-white/20', and a soft inner shadow.
ideas.per_age_variation: Little Dreamers: Golden/peach sparkle. Explorers: Earthy green/gold sparkle. Dreamweavers: Silver/lavender sparkle.
ideas.brand_risk_check: Moderate risk. It must NOT look like a 'chat bubble' or notification. Keep it purely decorative with no hover state or unread badges.

ideas.name: Foreground Depth Bleed (Atmospheric Perspective)
ideas.why_it_raises_wow: It creates a massive sense of 3D spatiality (depth of field) by placing heavily blurred static shapes in the extreme foreground corners, like looking through a magical lens.
ideas.css_technique: Use fixed 'pointer-events-none' divs in the bottom corners with 'filter: blur(40px)' and subtle opacity, overlapping the page edges slightly.
ideas.per_age_variation: Little Dreamers: A soft peach 'light leak' blur. Explorers: A muted sage 'leaf canopy' blur. Dreamweavers: A cool lavender 'mist' blur.
ideas.brand_risk_check: Low risk. Keep it purely atmospheric; z-index must be carefully managed to float over the background but remain strictly transparent so it never obscures text.
